limitations: contract_active_judgment is PURPOSE admission and was not persisted in 06_world/world.sqlite; derive_purposes.py evaluates it inline from mechanical contract facts plus stated as-of policy (2026-09-02).

05_dispositions.json left four MSAs UNRESOLVED for contract_active_judgment because adjudication packets lacked as-of policy; the derivation compiler applies purpose policy deterministically rather than replaying those UNRESOLVED packets.

obl:contract_active_judgment:contract:SOW-VEL-2022 lacks final_admitted_disposition in 05_dispositions.json; INACTIVE for the expired SOW is still derivable from contract_expiry_date and contract_doc_type in world.sqlite.
Commercial cluster edges (billing-to-contract, crm-to-contract) are fixed from identity_link_candidate completeness in world.sqlite rather than recomputed at derivation time.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical enumeration of undirected identifier pairs required to connect each CRM account, billed name, governing contract, and candidate registry rows per commercial cluster policy. No semantic disposition; pairs exist before reconciliation.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over entity_identifier commercial clusters minted during mechanical compilation; one row per required pair with left lexicographically before right.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Fixed VALUES list of 38 cluster pairs registered in world.sqlite; reproducible from cluster membership rules documented in 02_mechanical_report.json.
derivations.required_premise: entity_identifier tuples mint every canonical crm:, billing:, registry:, and contract: referent in scope.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Source-name relations help explain cluster membership but are not read by the registered SQL.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Filters invoice referents whose authoritative billing status equals open. No unresolved branch; invoices are either open or not per source status text.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over invoice_status; every invoice_status tuple is evaluated.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_status WHERE status = 'open'.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: PURPOSE-local ACTIVE | INACTIVE | UNRESOLVED judgment over each contract referent. Explicit expiry before evaluation date yields INACTIVE. Auto-renewal, rolling-term clause tags, or renewal language in term_text yield ACTIVE when not expired. Otherwise UNRESOLVED; absence of termination notice is never INACTIVE.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One judgment per contract referent implicated by purposes A or C; evaluated against evaluation_as_of without closed-world termination inference.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Python policy in derive_purposes.py: parse explicit expiry dates, intersect observed_clause kinds {auto_renewal, rolling_term}, and inspect term_text for rolling/month-to-month/successive-period language.
derivations.required_premise: Mechanical contract date, document-type, term, and clause tuples from world.sqlite.
derivations.optional_enrichment: contract_effective_date may support renewal arithmetic but is not required when renewal/rolling tags or explicit expiry decide status.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Blocks membership in acquisition_relevant_contract and blocks the current-relationship prong for purpose C dependency rows on that contract.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Excludes contract from acquisition-relevant and dependency derivations without emitting unresolved purpose rows for unrelated invoices.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A policy intersection: contract must be ACTIVE and bear at least one acquisition-relevant observed_clause kind from contracts/purpose_a.json allowed_kinds.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is contract referents with observed_clause rows; only ACTIVE contracts with qualifying clause kinds are emitted.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Active contracts where observed_clause.clause_kind is in purpose A allowed_kinds set.
derivations.required_premise: contract_active_judgment ACTIVE and qualifying observed_clause tuple on the same contract referent.
derivations.optional_enrichment: contract_doc_type supports expired-SOW exclusion already reflected in contract_active_judgment.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Contract is not acquisition-relevant; downstream purpose A rows for that contract are not generated unless another acquisition-relevant contract applies.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Maps identity_judgment between billing:<billed_name> and contract:<id> to association asserted when SAME_ENTITY, unresolved when UNRESOLVED. DISTINCT or missing judgment excludes the pair. Never infers association from absent identity evidence.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One association row per invoice tied to each acquisition_relevant_contract through the commercial billing-to-contract cluster edge.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join invoice_billed_name to billing identifier, cluster contract from identity_link_candidate billing-contract edge, filter acquisition_relevant_contract, project identity_judgment disposition through purpose A disposition_mapping.
derivations.required_premise: Invoice billed name, acquisition_relevant_contract membership, and identity_judgment on the billing-contract pair.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Forces association unresolved; invoice row is still emitted for purpose A when contract is acquisition-relevant.
Blocks asserted association; pair is omitted from purpose A output.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Does not suppress purpose A invoice row; records explicit unresolved association instead of omission.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A output projection. Emits invoices with asserted or unresolved association to an acquisition-relevant active contract. Does not treat unresolved identity as negative exposure.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every represented invoice linked to an acquisition_relevant_contract appears with full billing attributes and association asserted or unresolved.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join invoice mechanical attributes with invoice_contract_association; render contract_id and invoice_id with strip prefixes; sort by invoice_id ascending.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_contract_association row with association in {asserted, unresolved}.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Indirectly blocks row when contract never becomes acquisition_relevant.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Row is included with association unresolved per purpose A negative_finding_policy.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Projects each required identity_link_candidate pair to epistemic SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED using identity_judgment disposition. Missing judgment defaults to UNRESOLVED, never DISTINCT.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over identity_link_candidate; every candidate pair is emitted.
derivations.deterministic_computation: LEFT JOIN identity_link_candidate to identity_judgment on unordered pair; map disposition through contracts/purpose_b.json disposition_mapping; sort by left then right ascending.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Emitted as epistemic UNRESOLVED; does not block link row or imply DISTINCT.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose C current-relationship prong. Holds when an open invoice links to the contract counterparty cluster, or the contract is ACTIVE with auto_renewal or rolling_term observed_clause. Unresolved billing-to-contract identity prevents treating the open-invoice path as established for dependency status (handled in purpose_c_dependency_row).
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Evaluated per crm-to-contract commercial cluster with obligation kinds present on an ACTIVE contract.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Open invoices selected by billing cluster without requiring identity for listing; relationship prong also satisfied by ACTIVE contract with auto_renewal or rolling_term tags.
derivations.required_premise: ACTIVE contract with at least one purpose C obligation kind, plus open invoice in billing cluster and/or renewal/rolling clause on ACTIVE contract.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Blocks current-relationship via renewal/rolling path; open-invoice path may still list invoices but dependency status becomes unresolved downstream.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose C output. status dependent when both prongs hold and billing-to-contract and billing-to-crm identity are SAME_ENTITY. status unresolved when obligation/active prongs are met but required identity joins are UNRESOLVED or not SAME_ENTITY. Expired or inactive contracts produce no row.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Emit a row for each counterparty-contract cluster with ACTIVE obligation kinds and a current-relationship signal, either dependent or unresolved.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Iterate CRM-contract cluster pairs; collect sorted obligation_kinds from observed_clause; list open_invoice_ids from billing cluster; set status from identity_judgment on billing-contract and billing-crm pairs; render to purpose_ir/c/output.json sorted by contract_id.
derivations.required_premise: ACTIVE contract, non-empty purpose C obligation_kinds, and current-relationship prong (open invoice and/or renewal/rolling on ACTIVE contract).

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Forces status unresolved even when open invoices and obligation kinds are present.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Row is still emitted with status unresolved and open_invoice_ids populated from billing sources.
